description: This file defines the AccountTransferDetailAssembler class which provides methods to assemble transfer details between different types of accounts (savings and loan). It handles parsing JSON commands, retrieving account and client data, and constructing transfer detail objects.

classes.name: AccountTransferDetailAssembler
classes.description: Service component responsible for assembling account transfer details for various account transfer scenarios, including savings to savings, savings to loan, loan to savings, and loan to loan transfers.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Constructs transfer details for transferring between two savings accounts, given JSON command and account objects.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Constructs transfer details for transferring from a savings account to a loan account, given JSON command and account objects.

methods.name: assembleLoanToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Constructs transfer details for transferring from a loan account to a savings account, given JSON command and account objects.

methods.name: assembleLoanToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Constructs transfer details for transferring between two loan accounts.
